tasks.instruction: Type 'burn after reading test' into the editor, set the expiration dropdown to 'Burn after reading', click Send, and verify a share URL is produced on the resulting page.

Dismiss any banner. Type 'zerobin client-encrypted CUA test 2026' into the paste area, choose expiry '1 day', then click the 'Send' button. Wait for client-side encryption to finish and confirm the page displays the generated share URL containing the decryption key in the fragment (#).

Complete the Allstate auto insurance quote wizard for fictional driver Robert Kim, 45, at 789 Sunset Blvd, Los Angeles CA 90028, insuring a 2020 Honda Accord Sport, clean driving record, filling all personal, vehicle, and coverage screens and advancing through every multi-step page until the quoted premium with coverage options summary is displayed

Build an Allstate auto insurance quote for fictional driver Sandra Patel, 51, at 321 Ocean Drive, Miami FL 33139, insuring a 2022 Chevrolet Equinox LT, two drivers on policy including spouse age 50, and advance through all wizard steps until the personalized rate quote page showing premium options is shown

Search for licensed plumbers in Phoenix, AZ on Angi, filter by 'Highly Rated' and those offering free estimates, select a pro with at least 50 reviews, and click 'Request a Quote' to advance to the project details and contact form.
Configure a MacBook Pro: select a chip upgrade, more memory, and larger storage so the configured Mac with updated price is displayed.
Search train connections from Berlin to Munich for a chosen date and time, then open one result so its stop-by-stop itinerary is shown (stop before booking).
Enter a home price, down payment, rate and term into the mortgage calculator and reach the computed monthly payment with the amortization breakdown shown.

On Base64Encode.org, type a multi-line JSON string into the input field, select UTF-8 encoding, click the Encode button to produce the Base64 output string, then click the Download button to save the encoded result as a text file.
In BeFunky, open the Photo Editor with a sample image, apply the Artsy effect from the Effects panel, adjust the intensity slider to 70%, then click Save and download the image as a PNG.
Search for 'Sony A7 IV mirrorless camera', open the body-only listing, add to cart, then navigate to the cart and confirm the item.
Browse to Photo > Tripods & Support > Tripods, filter by brand 'Manfrotto' and load capacity over 10 lbs, open the first result, add to cart, then view the cart.
Open the retirement calculator, enter current age, savings, and contribution, then calculate so the projected retirement balance is shown.

Begin a Canadian eTA application from the canada.ca portal for a fictional UK citizen named Thomas Brown, passport number AB123456, born 07/04/1988, traveling for tourism, and complete all form pages including personal details, travel document information, and background eligibility questions until the application review and fee payment screen is reached

Start an order for pickup at the nearest Chicago location, build a chicken burrito bowl with brown rice, black beans, fajita veggies, medium salsa, sour cream, and guacamole, add to order, then proceed to checkout.

Use the Common App college search tool to find STEM-focused universities in California accepting applications, applying filters for state California, test-optional policy, and intended major Computer Science, advancing through all search and filter screens until the filtered college list with acceptance rates and application deadline details is displayed

Navigate the Common App to begin the first-year applicant application flow as a fictional student Jordan Lee, selecting Create Account, filling in the initial registration form fields including name, email commonapp.test.jordan@mailinator.com, graduation year 2025, and advancing through the account creation confirmation and initial application dashboard until the First Year application start screen is shown

Dismiss any consent/ad banner. Click into the large text box, type 'controlc.com CUA agent publish test 2026', leave the paste public, then click the 'Create New Paste' button at the bottom. Confirm the resulting page shows the saved paste with its numeric share URL.
Type 'expiry test note for cua' into the paste box, set the 'Paste Expiration' dropdown to '10 Minutes', click Create New Paste, and verify the new paste URL is displayed on the result page.

Navigate the Credit Karma personal loans marketplace, entering a loan request of $8,000 for medical expenses, and advance through the loan purpose, amount, and any pre-screening fields until the matched lender offers list with APR ranges and monthly payment estimates is displayed without requiring account login

Use Credit Karma's personal loan finder to search for offers on a $15,000 loan for major purchase, completing all available anonymous filter and loan-purpose screens, and advance until the lender comparison results showing estimated rates are visible on the results page

On CSGradient.io, set the gradient type to radial, add a third color stop at 50% with color #F59E0B, drag the first stop to position 10%, drag the last stop to position 90%, set the angle to 135 degrees, then click Copy to copy the CSS code and produce the gradient artifact.

On cubic-bezier.com, drag the first control point to approximately (0.17, 0.67) and the second to (0.83, 0.67) to create a bounce-like easing curve, compare it against the 'ease-in-out' preset using the comparison button, then select and copy the CSS cubic-bezier() value from the output field to produce the artifact.
Search for an item, filter to 'Buy It Now' and a condition, open a listing, select options, and add it to the cart so the cart page is shown.

Create a new pad (generate a random pad name), type a heading 'Project Brief', add three paragraphs describing a fictional product, then change the first line's text color to blue using the formatting toolbar. The finished pad with colored heading and content must be visible.

Dismiss cookie banner. Open a public-domain book from the catalog, on its detail page click the EPUB 'Download' button (free), and confirm the .epub download starts (browser download indicator appears).

Dismiss cookie banner. Search 'rocket', open a free icon (no premium crown), click the PNG 'Download' button, choose the free 512px size, and confirm the .png download begins (attribution modal may appear — close it and confirm download started).
Search for 'boAt Airdopes bluetooth earbuds', filter by customer rating '4★ & above' and price range ₹1000–₹3000, open the first result, add to cart, then go to cart.
Search a round-trip bus between Paris and Amsterdam, run it, and select outbound and return departures so the chosen round trip is shown.
Start an auto-insurance quote: enter a ZIP and advance through the first vehicle/driver information steps toward a quote.

Dismiss cookie banner if present. Type 'Ghostbin CUA test 2026 — anonymous paste' into the paste body field, set expiration to '1 hour', leave it unencrypted/public, then click the Paste/Create button. Confirm the result page displays the new paste's URL.

Enter a title 'cua-smoke' in the title field, type body text 'verifying ghostbin publish flow', choose expiry '1 day', click Create, and verify the published paste page shows the title and a share URL.

Use GoodRx to find the lowest price for Lisinopril 10mg, 30 tablets, near ZIP code 10001 (New York, NY), entering the drug name, selecting the correct dosage and quantity, entering the ZIP code, and advancing through all search and filter steps until the pharmacy comparison list with coupon prices is displayed

Search GoodRx for Metformin 500mg, 90 tablets near ZIP code 90210 (Beverly Hills, CA), selecting the extended-release variant, comparing CVS, Walgreens, and Costco prices, and advance through drug search, dosage selection, and pharmacy comparison screens until the full coupon savings comparison with prices at three or more pharmacies is shown

Navigate the healthcare.gov anonymous plan shopping tool for a family of 3 in ZIP code 07030 (Hoboken, NJ), entering household income of $72,000 and two adults aged 38 and 36 plus one child age 7, advancing through all steps until the plan comparison results page with premium estimates is displayed

Complete the healthcare.gov window-shopping flow for a single 29-year-old in ZIP code 90210 with annual income of $38,000, selecting no tobacco use, and advance through every step until the Bronze and Silver plan options with tax credit estimates are shown on the results screen

Complete the HMRC estimate your take-home pay calculator by entering an annual gross salary of £45,000, selecting the 2024-25 tax year, standard personal allowance, no student loan, Scotland not selected, and advancing through all input fields until the estimated net pay, income tax, and National Insurance breakdown result is displayed

Use the HMRC take-home pay estimator for a £62,000 annual salary, 2024-25 tax year, with a 5% pension contribution, Plan 2 student loan, filling all required fields including deductions and advancing through every screen until the itemized net pay and deductions summary is shown

Open a public/demo contact form template that allows direct submission (or the Jotform 'Contact Us' demo). Dismiss cookie banner. Fill Name 'CUA Test', Email 'cua-test@example.com', and a Message 'Automated CUA submission 2026', then click Submit. Confirm the 'Your submission has been received' thank-you page is shown.

In JSFiddle, write HTML with a <canvas> element 600x400, write JavaScript that draws a blue filled rectangle and a red circle on the canvas, click Run to produce the rendered canvas output, then save the fiddle.
Search flights for a route and dates, apply a stops filter and a max-price filter, then select a result so its booking-options screen is reached.
Plan a bike tour, set start and end points and drag the route to adjust it, and confirm the planned tour with stats is shown.
Plan a hiking route: set a start location, choose the hiking sport, and add waypoints on the map so the planned route with distance and elevation profile is displayed.

Complete the Lemonade renters insurance quote flow for fictional renter Emily Chen, 28, renting at 250 W 50th St Apt 4B, New York NY 10019, with personal property value of $20,000, no pets, and no prior claims, advancing through all wizard screens including address, coverage, deductible, and personal details until the monthly premium quote with policy summary is displayed
Customize a Lenovo laptop, change the display and storage options, and confirm the build total is shown.
Customize a Lenovo ThinkPad: upgrade processor, memory, and storage so the configured laptop with new total price is displayed.

Dismiss cookie banner. Search for a public-domain title (e.g. 'Pride and Prejudice'), open its book page, click the 'Download' button, choose the EPUB format, and confirm a file download begins (download started indicator / browser download bar shows the .epub).

Find Medicare Advantage plans for a beneficiary in ZIP code 60614 (Chicago, IL) using the anonymous plan finder, filtering for plans with dental coverage, and advance through all wizard steps until the filtered plan list with premium and deductible details is shown

Use the Medicare Plan Finder to search for Part D drug plans for a beneficiary with ZIP code 10001 (New York, NY) who takes Lisinopril 10mg daily, advancing through the drug entry and pharmacy selection screens until the ranked plan comparison results with estimated annual costs are displayed
Search for 'Samsung Galaxy A55 5G', filter by condition 'Nuevo' and free shipping, open the first result from a Tienda Oficial, add to cart, then go to the cart.

Complete the MoneySuperMarket car insurance quote journey for fictional driver Amir Hassan, born 10/05/1980, at 78 Corporation Street, Birmingham B2 4SW, driving a 2019 BMW 3 Series 320i, comprehensive cover, three years no claims bonus, filling every section including vehicle details, driver history, and cover type until the ranked insurer quote comparison page is displayed

Build a MoneySuperMarket car insurance comparison for fictional driver Fiona MacDonald, born 30/11/1995, at 15 Royal Mile, Edinburgh EH1 1PG, driving a 2021 Vauxhall Corsa 1.2, no claims history, comprehensive cover, advancing through all quote form sections until the results page with insurer options and annual premium prices is shown

Navigate NerdWallet's personal loan calculator, entering a $20,000 loan at 60-month term, then use the credit score slider to set score to 680, adjust filters for home improvement purpose, and advance through all input fields until the estimated monthly payment and total interest cost result is displayed

Use the NerdWallet personal loan comparison tool to find loans for $10,000 over 36 months for debt consolidation with a credit score of 700, filling in all filter fields including loan purpose, amount, and credit range, then advance until the ranked lender comparison results with APR and monthly payment estimates are displayed
Navigate to PC Components > Video Cards, filter by brand 'NVIDIA', VRAM '16GB', and sort by best rating, open the top result, add to cart, then go to the cart page.
Search for 'Samsung 990 Pro SSD 1TB', open the product, select the bundle without heatsink, add to cart, then proceed to checkout.
Browse to Boys > School Shoes, filter by width 'Standard' and size 3, open the first black lace-up result, add to bag, then view the bag.
Customize a Nike By You shoe: choose colors for two parts of the shoe and select a size so the configured shoe with price is displayed.
Open the tip calculator, enter a bill amount and tip percentage, and confirm the computed tip and total are shown.
Switch the search type to Audio, search 'piano', open a CC-licensed audio result, click its Download control, and confirm an audio file download begins.
Dismiss any banner. Search 'forest', open an openly-licensed image result, click the 'Download' button (choose a size if offered), and confirm the image file download starts from the source.
Search for 'Nike Sneaker Herren', filter by size '43' and color 'Schwarz', open the first result, select the size, add to cart, then view the shopping cart.
Enter zip code '90210', choose carryout, order a large BBQ chicken pizza on original crust, add extra jalapeños and extra cheese, add to order, then proceed to checkout.
Type 'cua description test' in the Description field, paste body 'verifying paste.ee publish', set expiry '1 hour', click Submit, and verify the result page shows the description and the share URL.

Dismiss cookie banner. In the paste content area type 'paste.ee guest CUA test 2026', set 'Paste Expiration' to '15 minutes' and visibility to Public, then click the Submit/Paste button. Confirm the published paste page loads at a /p/ URL and the content is shown.
Type a block of text into the new-paste editor, set an expiration and syntax highlighting, create the paste, and confirm the resulting paste URL/page is shown.
Start a new system build, add a CPU and a compatible motherboard from the part pickers, and reach the build summary showing both parts and a compatibility note.
Dismiss cookie banner. Search for 'mountains', open a photo result, click the green 'Free Download' button, choose the default/Original size if prompted, and confirm the .jpg image download starts.
Search 'coffee', open a photo, open the Download dropdown, select the 'Medium' size option, click Download, and confirm the image file download begins at the chosen resolution.

Dismiss cookie/consent banner. Search 'sunset', open an image result, click the 'Download' button, pick a resolution from the size list, then click the final Download. If a captcha-free direct download is available confirm the file download starts; otherwise confirm the download dialog with the chosen size is shown.
Open Pixlr E, create a new 800x600 white canvas, draw a filled rectangle using the shape tool, apply the Gaussian blur filter from the Filter menu, then export the result as a JPEG file.

On Placehold.co, construct a URL for a 800x400 image with a dark background (#1E293B) and white text (#F8FAFC) displaying the text 'Product Screenshot', then open that URL in the browser and save the displayed placeholder image using right-click > Save Image As.

On QR-Code-Generator.com, select the URL tab, enter 'https://example.com/product/42' as the target URL, change the QR code color to dark blue, add a logo from the provided options, then click Download to save the QR code image as PNG.

Build a Remitly transfer quote for $1,000 USD from the US to India via bank deposit, selecting Express delivery, and navigate through all corridor and delivery method steps until the fee breakdown and final recipient amount in INR are displayed on the transfer summary page

Use the Remitly send money calculator to get a transfer quote for sending $500 USD from the United States to Mexico via bank deposit, selecting Economy delivery speed, and advance through the corridor selection and delivery method screens until the exchange rate, fees, and recipient-gets amount are shown on the quote summary screen
Plan a route from Phoenix to San Diego and add a food/coffee stop along the way so the multi-stop route with stops is rendered on the map.
Plan travel from Lisbon to Madrid, open the train option, and expand it so the detailed schedule and price for that leg are shown.
Search for a primary care visit in New York City, filter by in-person visits, select a provider under $75, pick an available appointment slot this week, and advance to the checkout page.

On TableConvert, paste a CSV with 4 columns and 5 data rows into the CSV input tab, click Convert, switch to the Markdown output tab to see the formatted table, then click the Download button to save the Markdown file.
Search for 'cast iron skillet', filter by brand 'Lodge', select the 12-inch skillet, add it to cart, then go to the cart page.
Browse to the Kids' Backpacks category, filter by color 'Blue' and price range under $30, open the first result, select quantity 2, add to cart, and proceed to checkout.
Search for 'electric can opener', filter by price under $15, open the first result with 500+ reviews, add to cart, then view the cart.
In tldraw, draw three rectangles connected by arrows to form a simple flowchart, add text labels 'Start', 'Process', 'End' to each shape, then export the drawing as a PNG file using the Export menu.
Build a Toyota RAV4: choose a trim, exterior color, and add an accessory so the configured vehicle with total price is displayed.

Navigate the travel.state.gov passport application wizard selecting the option for a first-time passport for a child under 16, answering all screening questions for a fictional child Sarah Miller born 09/12/2015, and advance through all wizard steps until the required documents checklist and appointment recommendation screen is shown

Complete the TurboTax TaxCaster tax refund estimator for fictional filer Alex Johnson, single, no dependents, W-2 income of $68,000, federal withholding of $9,500, standard deduction, no other income or deductions, filling all income and filing status fields and advancing through every TaxCaster screen until the estimated federal refund or amount owed result is displayed
Search for 'HEATTECH Extra Warm turtleneck', select the women's version, choose colour 'Black' and size M, add to bag, then view the shopping bag.
Search for 'mountain sunrise', open a photo, and trigger the free download so the image download begins.

Fill out the USA.gov benefit finder as a 34-year-old married parent of two children under 18 in Florida with household income of $45,000, selecting all applicable life events including pregnancy, and advance through every wizard step until the full eligibility results page is shown

Complete the USA.gov benefit finder questionnaire as a 42-year-old unemployed single adult living in Texas with no disability and annual income under $30,000, advancing through all category and eligibility screens until the matched benefits results list is displayed

Find COVID-19 booster vaccine providers near ZIP code 60601 (Chicago, IL) using Vaccines.gov, selecting the COVID-19 vaccine, entering the ZIP code, filtering results to show only locations open within 5 miles, and advance through all filter and search steps until the provider list with addresses and availability status is shown

Use Vaccines.gov to find flu shot locations near ZIP code 30301 (Atlanta, GA), selecting flu vaccine type, entering the ZIP code, and advancing through the vaccine type and location search until the map and list of nearby providers offering flu vaccines with available appointment indicators is displayed

Navigate vote.gov to locate Pennsylvania absentee ballot request information, select Pennsylvania from the state picker, follow through to the official Pennsylvania voting portal, and advance through the absentee ballot application screens until the form submission or confirmation step is reached

Use vote.gov to begin voter registration for Michigan, clicking through the state selection and eligibility confirmation screens, then follow the redirect to the official Michigan online voter registration portal and advance until the personal information entry form is fully loaded and ready for input

Complete the vote.org registration wizard for the state of Georgia using fictional voter details for James Williams, born 03/22/1985, at 456 Peach St, Atlanta GA 30301, filling every required field and advancing until the submission confirmation screen or official Georgia redirect page is displayed
Search for 'Tide pods laundry detergent', filter results to 'In Stock' and sort by best seller, open the highest-rated option, select the 72-count size, add to cart, then navigate to checkout.
Search for organic whole milk, filter by brand 'Horizon', select the 64 fl oz size, add to cart, then proceed to cart page.
Search for 'mid century modern bookshelf', filter by color 'Walnut', price range $100–$300, and 5-star rating, open the first result, add to cart, then go to the cart.
Browse to Outdoor > Outdoor Rugs, filter by size '5x8', color 'Blue', and in-stock only, open the top-rated result, add to cart, then proceed to checkout.

Use the Western Union online flow to obtain a quote for sending $200 USD from the US to Nigeria for cash pickup, navigating all send amount, destination, and delivery method screens until the fee-inclusive total and exchange rate are shown on the transfer review page

Complete the Western Union send money flow to get a quote for sending $300 USD from the US to the Philippines via mobile wallet, entering all required origin and destination details, and advance through every step until the exchange rate, transfer fee, and total cost summary screen is displayed

Open a complete public-domain work's main page (e.g. search 'The Time Machine'), use the sidebar 'Download as EPUB' / 'Download as PDF' export tool, wait for the rendering job to finish, and confirm the generated EPUB/PDF file downloads.

Use the Wise transfer calculator to get a quote for sending $500 USD from the United States to Germany in EUR via bank transfer, selecting the recipient-gets tab, entering the amount, and advancing through the currency and delivery method selection until the fee breakdown, exchange rate, and arrival time estimate are all shown on the transfer quote screen

Search WorldCat for the book 'The Midnight Library' by Matt Haig, enter ZIP code 10001 to find nearby libraries, click through to the item details, and advance through the library availability search and location filter until the list of local libraries holding the book with availability status is displayed

Search WorldCat for 'Atomic Habits' by James Clear, filter results to show only eBook formats, select the DigitalLibraries option, enter ZIP code 90210 to locate nearby libraries offering digital borrowing, and advance through all search, format filter, and library selection steps until the library lending options page with borrow or place-hold links is displayed

Use Xoom to build a money transfer quote for sending $400 USD from the US to Colombia via bank deposit, completing all corridor selection, amount, and delivery method fields, and advance until the transfer review screen showing fees, exchange rate, and recipient amount in COP is displayed
